description: 47 patches across Feeld, FolderSync, Hidrate Spark, Meetup, Met Office, Tinder, and X, plus universal PairIP license-check bypass, universal OneTrust consent-banner auto-reject, and universal MITM patches (trust user CAs + bypass OkHttp pinning). For X 12.7.1-release.0 use 'Show age-restricted and sensitive media': it drops the media-visibility results X attaches to covered posts, so neither the age-restricted 'verify your age' cover nor the ordinary sensitive-media cover is built and the media renders directly. Complements Piko's 'Show sensitive media', which handles the older sensitive-media warning but not the age-verification variant. The remaining X patches ('Bypass PairIP integrity', 'Remove promoted timeline items') are still pinned to 12.4.1 and default-off. Purchase-breaking Tinder paywall patches and the umbrellas are default-off too.
